stem.text: A uniform beam PQ rests horizontally on a support at point S.

stem.alt: Horizontal beam PQ resting on a triangular support at point S, with a rope attached at end P at an angle of 60° to the vertical. Dimensions 2.5 m (P to Q) and 0.30 m (S to Q) are shown; the rope is labelled F.

stem.text: A rope is attached at one end of the beam. The rope is at an angle of $60^{\circ}$ to the vertical and exerts a force $F$, in newtons, on the beam.
What is the moment, in $\text{N m}$, of the force $F$ about the point S?
